Subject: Post-call: Alignment and proposed MAP + next steps

Alex / team — thanks again for today’s call. Quick recap and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to keep momentum. I’ve attached a draft MAP and the security questionnaire you asked about.

Key points from discovery:
- Primary use case: clinical triage automation for pre-visit intake; latency SLO of <250ms for 95th pctl on short prompts.
- Decision criteria: accuracy on clinical prompts, data controls (encryption + SOC2 evidence), predictable unit economics.
- Stakeholders we heard today:
  • Economic buyer: Alex Morgan (CTO) — final sign-off on budget and vendor selection
  • Security & Compliance: Jane Doe (Head of Security) — SOC2 + data residency requirements
  • Procurement: Elaine Park — PO, contract and legal redlines
- Timeline: target decision by mid-Nov / procurement completion by end of Nov (approx 6–7 weeks).

Proposed next steps (MAP highlights):
1) Share editable MAP + security questionnaire (attached). Owner: Camila (Redwood). Due: Oct 17.
2) Pilot scope and pricing estimate (15–30 day pilot) — initial budget ballpark requested. Owner: Ben (Redwood). Due: Oct 20.
3) Security review + SOC2 artifact exchange. Owner: Jane (Nexa) / Camila to coordinate. Due: Oct 24.
4) Legal/procurement review and PO. Owner: Elaine (Nexa). Due: Nov 7.

Attachments in this message: Nexa_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Nexa_SecQuestionnaire.pdf (filled questionnaire template).

Can we lock a 30-min sync next week to walk the MAP and pilot scope? I’m available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Thanks,
—Camila Reyes
